name: Zombie Gorge: Survival Defense
description:
Zombie Gorge: Survival Defense is an intense wave-based action shooter where you must protect a narrow mountain gorge from endless undead hordes. Build defenses, upgrade your weapons, unleash powerful abilities, and fight through escalating waves of zombies and mutated bosses. Every wave grows harder. Every upgrade matters.
Can you hold the Gorge… or will the dead break through?
